pr_comments: Do we have idea when the will be merged?
@bdraco and @dgomes will this make the next release then?

> will this make the next release then?

That depends if the requested code changes are made in time. That is up to the author of this PR. Please be patient.

> The integration is looking in `entry.data` for these values
> 
> ```
>     cool_away_temp = config.data.get(CONF_COOL_AWAY_TEMPERATURE)
>     heat_away_temp = config.data.get(CONF_HEAT_AWAY_TEMPERATURE)
> ```
> 
> The existing values need to be migrated to `.options` and the code in `__init__.py` needs to be updated to look for them in `.options`
> 
> The homekit integration has examples of migrating the data from .data to .options

I'll take a look at homekit. Thanks for the tip!
@dgomes looks like we still have one more change pending here for approval? Can we push this forward?

@rdfurman its been months and this still hasn't been closed out. IS there any way you can finish the last bit of code here? None of the away temp automation works without this option. If its too much, then at least revert back to the original YAML based integration. @bdraco if @rdfurman is not able to make these changes, is there away to have the Honeywell integration rolled back to the YAML based version since so much of it is not working? We have this open for a long time and there is no point to break what worked in YAML only to make it pretty in UI with half the functionality.

> @rdfurman its been months and this still hasn't been closed out. IS there any way you can finish the last bit of code here? None of the away temp automation works without this option. If its too much, then at least revert back to the original YAML based integration. @bdraco if @rdfurman is not able to make these changes, is there away to have the Honeywell integration rolled back to the YAML based version since so much of it is not working? We have this open for a long time and there is no point to break what worked in YAML only to make it pretty in UI with half the functionality.


This integration needs additional codeowners. Rolling back to the old version is only a short term solution which will likely have the side effect of reducing the number of maintainers to 0, and will shift the burden to whoever picks up maintaining the integration next which may mean nobody is willing to do so. That seems counter productive to the resolving the problem that there are not enough maintainers of this integration.

There are a few options:

- You can open a PR to make the changes yourself
- You can recruit someone to make the changes
- You can checkout the old integration and copy it in as a custom component
- ... and something else I haven't thought of

I've been focusing my free time on the ongoing issue with the retry functionality not generating unique IDs. There is still quite a bit of work to do for this PR: implement and test @bdraco's suggestion for migration, make the integration is actually honor the away temps, etc. etc. So it isn't just a matter of cherry-picking bdraco's commit over and pushing the change. But I will jump back to this as soon as the unique IDs issue (#57217) is sorted out.

@rdfurman any chance you can provide an update on this request? I realize you are working on a lot of unforeseen challenges when this was implemented, so we greatly appreciate all that you do. But would be nice to get this config option implemented as well...
For sure, now that it seems like the integration has stabilized somewhat I can focus on getting this across the finish line next.
Thanks again @bdraco for sending along that migration code! I've implemented it along with a test to make sure it works. This PR is ready for review again.
Could use some eyes on this PR please and thank you. I don't want it to go stale and close on me.

@bdraco / @dgomes can you all please look into this? @rdfurman finally put in the closing touches but this has stalled? I am simply trying to bump it in the event that we are missing something small to get this into the next HA stable release?
I took care of regenerating the `en.json` strings with [python3 -m script.translations develop](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/54704/commits/ce302889d7020eaf58bff3c63de7583e16877b1b)
